concepts.name: Counseling Agency Registry
concepts.summary: Spring Boot service managing counseling agencies for the platform: agency master data, addresses, and public agency lookup used during asker registration.

concepts.name: Agency Administration
concepts.summary: AgencyAdminController with AgencyAdminControlsFacade covers the admin-facing lifecycle: creating, updating, and configuring agencies (including topic assignment and admin controls).

concepts.name: Agency Search & Matching
concepts.summary: Public agency search resolves the right agency for an asker (postcode/topic-based matching) before registration completes.

flows.name: Agency Lookup During Registration
flows.summary: Asker enters registration context → public agency search (AgencyController) returns matching agencies → selected agency determines the consulting setup downstream.
